automation_duration_p90: P90 {duration} · with the wait in the queue
automation_flow_hint: from the lane after the first run to today's
automation_months_label: Documents per month by the lane of their first run
automation_hits_text: A person decided {decided} documents. {untouched} documents came through green and nobody touched them: not contradicted, not counted.
automation_hits_none: Nobody decided a field in this period yet.
automation_hits_early: A person decided {count} fields before the first run stopped: not counted.
automation_steps_hint: first run · median and P90 per document
classifier_model_trained_until: trained on {date} · from {examples} examples up to {until}
classifier_tested: Tested on {tested} examples held back (trained on four fifths):
classifier_next_text: since the examples of model {number}. Then Lekto trains by itself; “Train now” does not wait for it.
classifier_first_text: confirmed documents the first model needs. Then Lekto trains by itself.
classifier_history_label: Accuracy of the models for contact and document type
classifier_history_none: The history shows once two models are measured.
classifier_signals_hint: in operation · web and API · 12 months
classifier_signals_none: Nobody decided a field yet that a signal suggested something for.
search_meaning_of: {embedded} of {indexed} in the index have vectors
search_sections_label: sections with a vector · ⌀ {average} per document
search_check_extra: left over · in the index, but deleted
jobs_worker_never: No worker has started a job yet
jobs_none_open: No open jobs: the workers have nothing to do.
jobs_retry_document: The step runs again; processing goes on from there.
jobs_open_info: Running jobs first, then the due ones by due time, then the planned ones (retries after a failure, recurring jobs). Each worker loop takes jobs of its own kinds, so there is no fixed position.
jobs_order_note: in the order the workers take them
jobs_failed_info: A job has failed once all its attempts are used up. Admins try it again; a failed processing step is repeated at its document. Failed jobs stay until the end of the retention period.
jobs_done_info: Waited: from due to started. Ran: from started to done. Done jobs stay until the end of the retention period (LEKTO_RETENTION, seven days by default); then Lekto removes them.
jobs_durations_info: Median and 90th percentile of the done jobs per kind within the retention period. A long wait: too few workers or a backlog. A long run: the step itself (OCR, language model, embedding).
search_state_info: Documents in the database, entries in the index; “With vectors” also counts an earlier model’s. “Check thoroughly” tells whether all is current. A reconciliation every six hours and at worker start fills gaps.
search_open_info: Every event at a document makes an index job; it reads the current state and writes it to the index. “Done in about” is estimated from the index jobs of the last ten minutes.
search_durations_info: Median and P90 of the done index jobs within the retention period, with and without embedding. The time lies almost entirely with the embedding service; the index writes a document in milliseconds.
search_check_info: Compares every document in the database with the index and counts what is missing, outdated, embedded with another model or gone. It queues no jobs; the reconciliation or a rebuild repairs it.
search_reindex_info: Builds a new index from the database and the object store next to the active one, then swaps it in. Needed after a change of the embedding model or when “Check thoroughly” shows many outdated entries.
search_reindex_confirm_text: While it rebuilds, Lekto searches by words only, not by meaning. With many documents it takes hours; the search keeps working meanwhile.
maintenance_info: These actions catch up on existing documents with what Lekto does by itself for new ones. Each queues one job per matching document, never twice. The count per row: jobs waiting or running.
maintenance_queued_none: Nothing to queue: everything is done or queued already.
maintenance_relate_info: Finds the relations of every document not in processing again, both ways. For documents from before the step “relate” or after a type became a relation target. Relations people set or rejected stay.
maintenance_relate_confirm: A job is queued for every document that is not being processed. With many documents it takes a while; relations set by people stay.
maintenance_pages_info: Renders the page images of documents received before the step “pages” existed (the step is skipped there). The preview needs the images, and the vision model reads them.
maintenance_pages_confirm: A job is queued for every document without page images.
maintenance_facts_info: Reads the facts of every document with a text that is not being processed again: the codes on its pages (QR, GiroCode, barcodes), the identifiers and numbers in its text, and whose the IBANs and creditor IDs are. For documents from before an update that reads facts differently.
maintenance_facts_confirm: A job is queued for every document with a text that is not being processed.
maintenance_logos_info: Fetches the logo of every contact without one that has a domain identifier entered from its website (HTTPS, public addresses only); a learned domain only once you take it over. After a failure, only at the contact. An uploaded logo is never replaced.
maintenance_logos_confirm: A job is queued for every contact without a logo that has a domain entered; the worker asks the websites.
maintenance_logos_off: Lekto does not fetch logos: LEKTO_LOGO_FETCH is off.
automation_first_info: Each document counts by the lane its first run stopped in: green, Lekto filed it without asking; yellow, a person had to review; red, a step failed. For the chosen channels and period.
automation_duration_info: Turnaround: from receipt until the first run stopped (filed or a review). Work: only the time a worker spent on the document. Median and P90 over the counted documents.
automation_flow_info: From the lane after the first run to today’s: what people made of yellow and red documents and whether green documents became yellow again later.
automation_months_info: The documents per month of their receipt by the lane of their first run, in your time zone. It shows whether more gets through without a review over time.
automation_hits_info: Per field: how often the first run’s value stood at a person’s first decision (taken over or suggestion accepted). Green documents nobody touched do not count: not contradicted, but not confirmed.
automation_steps_info: How long each step of the first run took per document, median and P90. The longest bar shows where the time goes.
classifier_model_info: The model learns contact, type, topic, tags and space from confirmed documents and suggests them for new ones. The accuracy comes from examples held back at training.
classifier_next_info: Lekto trains by itself once enough new confirmed documents came in since the last model; the bar shows the way there. “Train now” does not wait for that.
classifier_history_info: The accuracy of every model, tested at training on examples it has not seen. When it stops rising, more and more varied confirmed documents help.
classifier_signals_info: How often a signal’s best suggestion was the value a person confirmed at the first decision; below, how often it suggested anything. Web and API, twelve months. Only the language model reads the date.
job_kind_documents_remove_files: Removing the files of a deleted document
login_tagline: Your documents, self-hosted. Recognised, filed and searchable.
login_totp_hint: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
login_recovery_hint: Enter one of your recovery codes.
error_too_many: Too many attempts. Please try again in {seconds} seconds.
error_too_many_later: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
dev_sample_dialog_text: Dialogs close with Escape or the button.
lens_filter_hint: The filters come from the sidebar; change them there, then save.
lens_due_hint: A date field: yellow from 7 days before, red once passed.
lens_grouping_due_hint: By deadline only with a deadline.
lens_fields_hint: Up to 3, in this order; drag them or move them with the arrows.
lens_preview_hint: An amount and the deadline share a line; other fields stand as name and value below. A field a document does not have is left out.
lens_delete_confirm: The lens goes; its documents stay.
lens_changed: Filters, words or sort differ from the lens.
documents_none: No documents yet. Documents come in through the inbox.
document_not_found: This document does not exist or you may not see it.
document_moved_away: The rules filed the document where you can no longer see it.
pdf_missing: The file is not available yet.
processing_failed: Processing stopped with an error. See the log below; you can repeat the step.
processing_review: Some fields wait for confirmation in the inbox.
edit_read_only: You may read this document but not change it.
dryrun_hint: Nothing is stored yet. Save to apply the change.
move_hint: Choose the space the document goes to. Hand it over to another user, and it lies in their personal space afterwards, in their inbox.
space_named_unseen: Named, but would not see it there: {names}
visible_to_readers_later: {names} read it once it is green
filing_hint: Where it lies and who sees it
filing_lead_hand_over: Lekto suggests handing the document over to {name}.
filing_lead_move: Lekto suggests filing the document in {space}.
filing_lead_disagree: The signals name different spaces. Choose where it belongs.
filing_move_unseen: Into a space you cannot see
filing_unavailable: You may not file it there.
filing_stays: Who sees it stays as it is.
filing_hand_over_consequence: You will no longer see it. {name} finds it as new in the inbox.
filing_hand_over_admin: {name} finds it as new in the inbox.
filing_decided_lekto: filed by Lekto, not confirmed yet
filing_hint_hand_over: The document will be handed over to {name}. You will no longer see it.
filing_hint_hand_over_admin: The document will be handed over to {name}.
filing_hint_move_readers: The document will move to {space}, newly visible to {names}.
filing_lead_move_person: Lekto suggests filing the document with {name}.
filing_hint_move_person_readers: The document will move to {name}, newly visible to {names}.
reprocess_hint: Results from the chosen step on are discarded and made anew.
reprocess_vision_lost: Text recognition then reads without the VLM again; its text is lost.
reprocess_vision_again: Read with the VLM again, as last time
delete_confirm: “{title}” and its files are deleted for good.
log_space_unseen: Named, would not see it there
log_step_fails: Condition does not hold: the rule ends here
log_step_not_asked: “{name}”: not asked outside processing; the rule ends here
upload_hint: PDF, JPEG, PNG or TIFF. Each file becomes a document.
upload_page_hint: You can also drag files and folders onto this page.
upload_drop_overlay_hint: Files and folders go into your personal space; the rules file them.
upload_duplicate_unseen: This file is already in Lekto, in a space you cannot see.
upload_skipped_type: Not a PDF, JPEG, PNG or TIFF
text_none: No text yet: the document is not read.
inbox_empty_done: Nothing left your inbox in the last 14 days.
inbox_all_seen_text: {count} new documents go to “Done”. There you can mark each of them as new again.
inbox_all_seen_text_one: One new document goes to “Done”. There you can mark it as new again.
inbox_empty: Nothing waits for you. All documents are filed.
review_nothing_open: Nothing is open on this document.
review_open_fields: These fields still need a decision: {fields}
search_slow: The search by meaning is taking longer right now …
search_meaning_pending: It is still being prepared; you can search with it once it is ready.
admin_only: Only admins may use this area.
profile_hint: Only the user and admins see the profile; others see the display name. When any of it stands in a document, Lekto knows whose it is. The language model gets only the display name.
profile_own_hint: Only you and admins see your profile; others see your display name. When any of it stands in a document, Lekto knows it is yours. The language model gets only your display name.
profile_display_name_hint: How others see the user; empty: the username.
profile_aliases_hint: A maiden name, for example: Lekto recognises the person by it in documents.
profile_identifiers_hint: IBAN, tax ID, social security and health insurance number, further e-mail addresses. Several users may share one (a joint account), a contact may not.
profile_numbers_hint: Your customer, contract and personnel numbers: found in a document, they tell its contact and that it is yours. Only you and admins see them, here and at the contact.
space_description_hint: What belongs in this space, e.g. “flat, utilities, providers, children”. The language model reads it when Lekto suggests a space; that of a personal space only for its own user's documents.
space_delete_confirm: Only an empty space can be deleted. Its rules go with it, and its members lose access.
space_leave_confirm: You no longer see the space's documents afterwards, until someone adds you again.
all_users_hint: Documents, inbox, rules and counts of all users, not only those of your spaces.
members_hint: “Read” shows the space's green documents. “Edit” shows every document in every lane and lets the member change, confirm, move and delete them, and look after the space's rules, members and name.
members_personal_hint: {name}'s personal space: what {name} uploads lands here, and {name} always edits it.
master_search_tags: Search tags, also by parent tags
open_suggested_contact: Probably belongs to {contact}: {count} confirmed documents show it with this name, for example in the bookings of a bank statement.
open_suggested_contact_one: Probably belongs to {contact}: one confirmed document shows it with this name, for example in a booking of a bank statement.
open_suggested_person: Probably belongs to {person}: in {count} confirmed documents it is the recipient's account.
open_suggested_person_one: Probably belongs to {person}: in one confirmed document it is the recipient's account.
open_dialog_hint_suggested_contact: Confirming enters it at the contact by hand: it then backs the contact in its own documents. Rejecting notes it there as rejected, and Lekto does not suggest it again.
open_dialog_hint_suggested_person: Confirming enters it in the profile: it then finds the person in documents. Rejecting notes it there as not theirs, and Lekto does not suggest it again.
open_hint: Training found the learned identifiers in confirmed documents. Unknown ones stand in confirmed documents but at no contact. Suggestions are IBANs and creditor IDs a document attributes to another contact or to a person.
open_none: Nothing open: every identifier in confirmed documents is entered or rejected.
open_skipped_one: One stands in documents of several contacts: taking over leaves it out.
open_skipped: {count} stand in documents of several contacts: taking over leaves them out.
open_unknown_in_one: Stands in one confirmed document, at no contact.
open_unknown_in: Stands in {count} confirmed documents, at no contact.
open_dialog_hint_learned: Taking over enters it at the contact. Rejecting takes it out there: Lekto does not learn it again, and it no longer counts as evidence.
open_dialog_hint_unknown: Taking over enters it at the chosen contact. Rejecting notes it rejected there: Lekto does not learn it.
master_delete_confirm: It can only be deleted while no document uses it.
tag_delete_confirm: Deleting works only without tags below it and while nothing uses it: no document, contact, type or rule.
contact_group_delete_confirm: Deleting works only without groups below it and while no contact is in it and no rule names it.
topic_delete_confirm: Deleting works only without topics below it and while nothing uses it: no document, contact, identifier or rule.
type_group_delete_confirm: Deleting works only without groups below it and while no document type is in it and no rule names it.
tag_assignment_hint: Lekto proposes and sets an automatic tag. A tag set by hand only is set by a person or a rule, such as a status like “to pay”.
topic_assignment_hint: Lekto proposes and sets an automatic topic. A topic set by hand only is set by a person or a rule.
tag_shown_hint: Filters, search, rules and templates see it either way.
topic_shown_hint: Filters, search, rules and templates see it either way.
tag_group_shown_hint: Shown next to the contact or type of a document; filters, search, rules and templates see it either way.
tag_kind_document_about: Traits of a document, automatic or by hand only
tag_kind_contact_about: group contacts; a document inherits them from its contact
tag_kind_type_about: group document types; a document inherits them from its type
tag_kind_topic_about: what a contact is about, enabled at the contact, one per document
tag_kind_hint: The kind decides what the tag belongs to. It cannot be changed later.
tag_kind_document_example: A trait of a document, e.g. “Tax 2026” or “to pay”
tag_kind_topic_example: What a contact is about, e.g. “Health insurance”
master_aliases_hint: One name per line. Choosing this contact in the review adds the name the model read.
master_description_hint: What belongs to this type, e.g. other names for it. The language model reads it when classifying.
field_def_hint: The data type cannot be changed later. Amounts carry their currency with each value.
field_period_unreadable: Unknown notation. Possible are 2026, 2026-Q2, 2026-03, 2026-W17, March 2026 or 2026-03-01/2026-03-14, for example.
field_def_description_hint: What belongs in the field and how documents call it, e.g. “the month's gross total, not the base salary; printed as Gesamt-Brutto”. The field's name is rarely on a document.
field_def_manual_hint: Lekto never asks the model for this field; a person or a rule sets it. If it is required, the document waits in the inbox until someone enters it.
review_by_hand: You enter this value by hand: Lekto does not read the field from the document.
field_def_key_hint: How templates of rules and title patterns write the field.
field_def_no_type: Not for any document type yet.
user_password_reset_done: Password reset. The user’s sessions ended.
user_totp_remove_confirm: The user can sign in with the password alone until they set it up again.
user_oidc_remove_confirm: The user can no longer sign in through the identity provider.
user_delete_confirm: Their sign-in data goes for good. Documents they uploaded stay, without “uploaded by”.
user_delete_spaces: The user alone holds these spaces. Decide for each:
oidc_error_denied: The identity provider did not sign you in.
oidc_error_failed: The sign-in expired, did not match, or no account here is linked to it.
oidc_error_conflict: This account at the identity provider is linked to another user.
oidc_error_provider: The identity provider cannot be reached right now.
webhook_url_hint: Receives a POST for every event.
webhook_trigger_events_hint: The webhook reports the chosen events. Rules can use it as well.
webhook_trigger_rules_hint: The webhook reports no events. Rules send through it or ask it.
webhook_volume_total_exact: Deliveries per document with this choice: {count}.
webhook_volume_total_range: Deliveries per document with this choice: about {least}⁠–⁠{most}.
webhook_volume_steps: Of them {least}⁠–⁠{most} from the processing steps; every reprocessing sends them again.
webhook_signed_hint: With a secret, shown once: the receiver checks the webhook-signature header with it. Without one, the receiver checks a header of its own, such as a token.
webhook_open_tasks_hint: How many requests that expect an answer (a rule step that asks) the webhook takes at the same time. More wait in Lekto; their time to answer starts when they are sent.
webhook_model_call_hint: The webhook answers this request for every document instead of the language model, sent as fixed JSON, not the body. Without an answer in time the document turns red. One active webhook per kind.
webhook_headers_hint: Go with every request, such as Authorization with a token. The values are stored encrypted and not shown again.
webhook_body_thin_hint: Only the event: type, ID, time and document ID. The receiver fetches details through the API.
webhook_body_full_hint: The event and the document as it is: title, contact, type, tags, date, lane, fields and a link.
webhook_body_template_hint: Your own JSON from a template, such as a notification for Home Assistant. The filter json writes a value as JSON.
webhook_renew_confirm: The old secret stops working at once. The receiver must use the new one.
webhook_delete_confirm: Its delivery log is deleted with it.
webhook_secret_hint: Shown only once. Store it now; the receiver verifies signatures with it.
password_hint: Changing it ends all your sessions, including this one, and signs you in again here.
totp_hint: A code from an authenticator app, asked for at each password sign-in.
totp_qr_label: QR code for the authenticator app
totp_scan: Scan the code with your authenticator app.
totp_manual: Or enter this key by hand:
totp_confirm_hint: Enter the current code from the app to turn the second factor on.
totp_disable_hint: Enter a current code or a recovery code.
totp_new_codes_hint: The old codes stop working. Enter a current code or a recovery code.
totp_codes_hint: Shown only once. Each works once if the app is lost. Store them safely.
oidc_link_bad_url: The identity provider answered with an address that is no web address.
oidc_unlink_confirm: You then sign in with your password only.
oidc_unlink_needs_password: Without a password the link cannot be removed.
sessions_hint: Signs you out in every other browser. This one stays.
sessions_end_confirm: Every other browser has to sign in again.
token_hint: For scripts and tools. A token never opens this web UI.
token_scope_hint: The token never has more rights than you.
token_expires_hint: Empty means it does not expire.
token_created_hint: Shown only once. Copy it now.
token_revoke_confirm: Tools that use it lose access at once.
rules_none: No rules yet. A rule tags, files and checks documents by their contact, type, text and more.
rule_title_pattern_hint: This rule carries out the title pattern of the document type {type}. It follows the pattern and is changed there; it can be applied to existing documents here.
rule_delete_confirm: The rule never runs again. Its versions stay readable for the processing log.
rule_version_hint: An earlier version, as it was saved. Versions cannot be restored; edit the rule to change it.
rule_scope_hint: A space's rule acts on the documents in that space, also when one arrives there (filed, moved or handed over); a global one on all. Whoever edits a space looks after its rules.
rule_scope_move_hint: Moving it takes editing both the space it is in and the new one; global only admins. The history shows the move.
template_missing: With “{title}”, {value} is missing: nothing would be set.
template_unreadable: Not readable for the type {type}: the action sets nothing.
template_preview_none: No preview without a reference document.
template_value_fact_list: All facts (kind, value, written, role, origin)
rule_save: Save and see what it does
rule_save_hint: A saved rule stays paused until you have seen what it would do.
rule_value_template_hint: Lekto reads what the template writes as the field’s type has it, such as 12.50 EUR or 15 March 2026; what it cannot read sets nothing.
rule_space_unreachable: a space you may not file into
rule_space_unreachable_hint: Someone who edits it saved this. You can save the rule only with a space you may file into yourself.
rule_send_webhook_hint: On arrival once the document is filed (a yellow one after it was confirmed), after a change once it is stored. The webhook's owner must be able to read the document.
rule_ask_name_hint: Small letters, digits and _. The steps after it see the answer as steps.<name>, in conditions and templates.
rule_ask_hint: The webhook gets a task and answers through its callback; the document waits for it (running externally). On arrival only. The webhook's owner must be able to read the document.
rule_missing_red: Red: the document waits, no rule acts
rule_missing_yellow: Yellow: the rule ends here, its steps before count
rule_condition_step_hint: If these conditions do not hold, the rule ends here; its steps before count. They see the document as the rule's steps before left it.
rule_step_path_hint: The name of a step before that asks, then keys of its answer: accounting.paid
rule_triggers_ask_hint: A rule that asks a webhook runs on arrival only.
rule_send_webhook_none: You have no webhook yet: create one under Webhooks. A rule sends through the webhooks of whoever saves it.
rule_error_amount: Enter an amount and a currency such as EUR.
rule_error_period: Enter From and To as dates; To not before From.
rule_error_operator: This comparison does not fit the field.
rule_error_group_empty: Add a condition or remove the group.
rule_error_triggers_ask: A rule that asks a webhook runs on arrival only: choose only “on arrival”.
rule_error_step_name: Small letters, digits and _, beginning with a letter (at most 50).
rule_error_timeout: From half a minute to {max} hours.
rule_error_path: The name of a step before, then keys, separated by dots (accounting.paid).
rule_error_step_unknown: No step before this one asks under this name.
rule_error_missing: Deleted or no longer visible; please choose another.
rule_apply_hint: What the rule's current version would change on existing documents. Nothing changes until you apply it.
rule_saved_hint: The rule is saved and paused. Here is what it would change on existing documents.
rule_preview_nothing: The rule would change no existing document.
rule_preview_loaded: {count} documents so far, more may follow.
rule_preview_restarted: The rule was changed meanwhile; the preview starts again.
rule_chain_loop: The chain stops: rules move it back and forth ({spaces})
source_jump: Go to the source on page {page}
review_banner_hint: Hover a field to see its source in the document.
review_banner_hint_phone: Tap a field's page to see its source in the document.
group_global_hint: Own fields of every document type
group_other_hint: Set, but not of the document type
edit_hint: Before saving, Lekto shows what the change does.
pages_preview: Preview until the archive PDF is ready
doc_processing_vision: The VLM is reading the pages · step {done} of {total}
files_no_archive: No archive yet: it comes with the text recognition.
files_unreadable: The file's metadata cannot be read (damaged or encrypted).
copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
prompt_document_note: The document's text is part of the message.
prompt_parts_note: Order: the system prompt (the same for every call), the document, the task; with json_object then the answer’s schema. Calls about a document begin alike, so an endpoint can cache that.
log_editors_only: The space's editors and admins see what the step did.
log_reading_page_content: page {page}: {unsure} of {words} words unsure, {content_unsure} of {content} content words
processing_overruled_settled: Uncertain, then settled by the rules: they filed the document into the space the verdict suggested.
summary_imported: taken over from the source system
summary_overruled_settled: uncertain, then settled by the rules
run_through: Run {run} went through without a review
run_through_confirmed: Run {run} filed the document after {name} confirmed it
run_through_decided: Run {run} filed the document after {name} decided
run_through_settled: Run {run} went through; the rules settled the space
run_why_space_open: The space is open; the signals name different ones.
run_why_evidence: {name} is clearly named in the text.
run_why_rule_review: A rule asks for a review.
run_band_hint: Point at a part to see its step
matrix_hint: For each property, which signal names it
matrix_cell_other: {signal} names {value}, without evidence in the text
master_identifiers_hint: IBAN, VAT number, customer, contract or personnel number (employer), the domain of e-mail and web addresses. One in a document is evidence for the contact. Lekto learns more from confirmed documents.
master_contact_groups_hint: The contact’s documents belong to these groups too.
master_contact_topics_hint: What documents of this contact are about: a document of the contact carries one of these topics at most, an identifier may point to one.
master_type_groups_hint: The type’s documents belong to these groups too.
topic_enables_hint: The contact does not have this topic yet: saving enables it at the contact.
facts_numbers_hint: Its own, a strand’s, or another document’s it refers to
facts_decide_rejected_hint: Rejected: it is no fact of the document. Restored, it counts again.
reason_fact_kind_unknown: “{kind}” is no kind of fact Lekto knows
reason_fact_not_in_text: “{value}” does not appear in the text
reason_relation_to_itself: a document does not refer to itself
reason_fact_filter_of_person: only admins find documents by a person’s numbers
reason_rule_fact_of_person: only admins write rules on a person's numbers
reason_fact_criterion_empty: a filter by facts names a kind, a role, or a kind with its value
reason_fact_not_asked: a fact “{kind}” in the role “{role}” was not asked for
reason_holder_not_listed: “{value}” was not among the numbers asked about
reason_holder_name_not_near: the name “{name}” does not stand near the number
reason_fact_of_a_person: the value is one of a person’s numbers
reason_fact_exists: the document has the fact {kind} “{value}” already
reason_fact_role_missing: a fact added needs its role
reason_fact_of_person: only admins decide the facts that are a person’s alone
reason_fact_at_contact_admin: only admins correct a fact at the contact too
reason_fact_not_at_contact: a {kind} is corrected at the contact only on a document with a contact, and only for the kinds a contact keeps
field_def_required_hint: A required field must be recognised, else the document waits in the inbox. An optional one may stay empty; a value it gets must stand in the document.
master_title_pattern_hint: Sets the title of the documents of this type; values and fields through the template editor on the right.
master_relation_target_hint: Contracts, policies and the like: documents with the same contract or customer number refer to documents of this type. Without it such a number connects no documents.
master_type_no_fields: No fields of its own yet.
master_title_rule: See the rule of the title pattern
master_icon_hint: Shown at documents and in lists, from Lucide's icons.
icon_search: Search icons, e.g. car or house
icon_load_failed: The icons could not be loaded. Reload the page.
icon_search_more: {count} more: another word narrows it down.
color_own_hint: Stored as #rrggbb. The chip mixes it with the background and the text colour, so it stays readable in light and dark.
logo_none: No logo: the contact shows its initials.
logo_failed: No logo found at {domains} (last on {date}); fetched there only on request.
logo_fetch_queued: The logo is being fetched; it shows once it is there.
logo_upload_hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 1 MB. Lekto keeps it at up to 128 pixels.
logo_fetch_hint: Asks the contact's own website (its domain entered among the identifiers) for its icon. An uploaded logo is never replaced.
logo_fetch_learned: Its domain is only learned: take it over among the identifiers, and Lekto fetches the logo from the website.
logo_after_create: Create the contact first, then give it a logo.
classifier_not_configured: No classifier is set up (LEKTO_CLASSIFIER is none).
classifier_accuracy_none: It is measured from 50 confirmed documents on.
classifier_train_queued: Training queued; it runs in the background.
candidate_llm_note: The language model gives no probability: the value tells how well the name it read matches the contact.
candidate_neighbours_similar: {votes} of {found} similar documents · similarity up to {similarity}
details_reading: How well each page was read
details_reading_hint: Share of unsure words per page
details_rgb: Colours converted to RGB for PDF/A
details_characters_total: {count} characters on {pages} pages, {average} per page on average
details_threshold_hint: Line: the threshold from which the classifier names a value
vision_hint: Every page goes as an image to {endpoint} (model {model}). Its text replaces the text recognition in the archive; classification, fields and rules run again afterwards.
vision_started: The VLM is reading the pages.
vision_advice_no_text: Text recognition found no text. The VLM can usually read it.
vision_advice_poor_page: Text recognition was unsure (page {pages}). The VLM usually reads such pages better.
expected_hint: Documents that come at a steady interval, and when the next one is due.
expected_none: No series yet: at least three documents of one contact and type at a steady interval make one.
stream_truncated: More than a stream shows: narrow the filter to see it whole.
relations_hint: to other documents; the newer refers to the older
relations_evidence_target: Lekto: {kind} {value}, as at the relation target
facts_hint: hover to mark it in the document, click to keep the mark
facts_hint_phone: tap to see where it stands in the document
facts_none: No names or identifiers in the text.
facts_pending: Facts and codes appear once the text is read.
fact_role_target: points to a contract, policy or meter
facts_third_hint: IBANs and creditor IDs of others, for example in bookings
facts_unknown_hint: Attach one as an identifier, and Lekto knows the contact by it.
facts_attach_admins: Admins attach identifiers (they are master data).
facts_other_contacts_one: Stands on documents of another contact too.
facts_other_contacts: Stands on documents of {count} other contacts too: probably your own account or number.
facts_attach_title: Attach the {kind} as an identifier to
facts_attach_hint: Documents with this identifier suggest this contact from now on. Undo it in the master data.
codes_hint: QR, matrix and bar codes with what they hold
codes_unread: The codes of this document are not read yet.
codes_mark: {format}: mark its content in the document
field_def_manual_line: Lekto never asks the model for this field.
identifier_learned_note: Lekto learned this identifier from confirmed documents. Taken over, it counts as one entered by hand and can be changed.
number_learned_note: Lekto found this number in confirmed documents that are surely yours. Taken over, it counts as one you entered.
number_declined_note: Not yours: Lekto will not learn it again.
identifier_rejected_note: Rejected: Lekto does not learn this identifier again.
files_step_sender: by the sender, as the file says
files_original_note: As the file arrived; Lekto never changes it.
reason_only_suggested: “{name}” is only suggested: no signal is sure of it
reason_contact_is_recipient: “{contact}” is the recipient, not the sender
reason_contact_identifiers_several: identifiers of several contacts stand in the text
reason_contact_new_proposed: no contact matches “{sender}”; a new contact is proposed
reason_contact_none_no_model: no contact recognised (the language model did not answer)
reason_contact_not_in_text: the contact “{contact}” does not appear in the text
reason_sender_not_a_contact: “{sender}” is no contact, and only other signals point to “{contact}”
reason_sender_only_similar: “{sender}” is only similar to the contact “{contact}”
reason_type_new_proposed: no document type fits; a new type “{type}” is proposed
reason_topic_without_contact: no contact: a topic belongs to a contact
reason_space_named_unseen: names someone who would not see it there
reason_space_stays_for_named: stays: the space the signals name leaves out someone it names
reason_space_shows_more: suggests another space, which shows it to more people
reason_space_hand_over: suggests handing it over into another user’s personal space
reason_space_uploader_unseen: suggests a space its uploader does not see
reason_date_none_from_model: no date recognised: the language model gave none ({why})
reason_same_as_document_date: the same date as the document date
reason_period_no_year: no year given; the year of the document date is assumed
reason_same_day_as_document_date: the same day as the document date
reason_field_by_hand_missing: “{field}” is set by hand and has no value yet
reason_field_not_read_no_model: “{field}” was not read: no language model is configured
reason_value_invalid: “{value}” is not a valid value of “{field}”
reason_quote_not_in_text: the quoted passage does not appear in the text
reason_quote_without_value: the quoted passage does not show the value
reason_quote_too_short: the quoted passage is too short to show the value
reason_date_not_in_text: the date does not appear in the text
reason_period_not_in_text: the period does not appear in the text
reason_amount_not_in_text: the amount does not appear in the text
reason_currency_not_in_text: the currency {currency} does not appear in the text
reason_number_not_in_text: the number does not appear in the text
reason_link_not_in_text: the link does not appear in the text
reason_text_not_in_text: the text does not appear in the document
reason_page_poorly_read: page {page} was poorly read ({share} of its words unsure)
reason_page_poorly_read_content: page {page} was poorly read ({share} of its content words unsure)
reason_surroundings_poorly_read: the text around the value was poorly read ({unsure} of {words} content words unsure)
reason_source_lacks_contact: no contact in the source system
reason_source_lacks_document_type: no document type in the source system
reason_source_lacks_document_date: no document date in the source system
reason_paperless_user_review: Paperless user “{name}”: to be checked in Lekto
reason_paperless_correspondent_review: Paperless correspondent “{name}”: to be checked in Lekto
reason_paperless_document_type_review: Paperless document type “{name}”: to be checked in Lekto
reason_paperless_tag_review: Paperless tag “{name}”: to be checked in Lekto
reason_paperless_custom_field_review: Paperless custom field “{name}”: to be checked in Lekto
reason_paperless_storage_path_review: Paperless storage path “{name}”: to be checked in Lekto
reason_paperless_asn_review: Paperless archive serial number “{name}”: to be checked in Lekto
reason_tag_is_group: tag “{tag}” is a group, not a document tag
reason_rule_other_space: the rule belongs to another space
reason_space_no_right_any_more: no right to file into space “{space}” (any more)
reason_space_no_right: you have no right to file into space “{space}”
reason_space_widens_unconfirmed: files into the space “{space}”, which more people see, with an unconfirmed {fields}; not accepted
reason_space_widens_needs_confirmed: files into the space “{space}”, which more people see, only with a confirmed {fields}
reason_review_on_arrival_only: reviews are forced on arrival only
reason_value_other_not_accepted: the document has another value ({value}); not accepted
reason_rule_value_on_unconfirmed: a rule set another value on unconfirmed values ({value})
reason_rules_value_on_unconfirmed: rules: a rule set another value on unconfirmed values ({value})
reason_rules_model_value_other: rules: the model set another value ({value})
reason_topic_person_chose: a person chose the topic “{topic}”, which this contact does not enable
reason_topic_not_enabled: its contact does not enable the topic “{topic}”
reason_tag_added_and_removed: tag “{tag}” is added and removed by rules
reason_tag_above_kept: tag “{tag}” is above a tag the document has
reason_node_attempts_exhausted: the step did not finish in {attempts} attempts (the worker stopped or ran out of time each time)
reason_file_not_pdf_or_image: the file is neither a PDF nor an image
reason_file_damaged: the file is damaged or not a valid document
reason_text_unreadable: the text in the PDF cannot be read (a font without a character map); every page was recognised from its image
reason_signature_dropped: the original is digitally signed; the archive does not carry the signature (the original is unchanged)
reason_colours_converted: the colours were converted to RGB to make the archive PDF/A (the original is unchanged)
reason_archive_not_pdfa: the archive could not be made PDF/A
reason_vision_read: every page was read by the vision language model {model} ({endpoint})
reason_vision_not_configured: a person asked for the vision language model, but none is configured
reason_no_text: no text recognised: the pages are blank or hold only pictures
reason_answer_unfit: the model’s answer does not fit the schema: {detail}
reason_nothing_recognised: nothing recognised: no contact, document type or date
reason_master_data_changed: the master data changed during the step; nothing was applied ({detail})
reason_metadata_unfit: the metadata of the source system no longer fits: {detail}
reason_taken_over: taken over from the source system
reason_space_changed_meanwhile: the space the signals chose changed meanwhile; it stays
reason_rules_back_and_forth: rules move it back and forth: {spaces}
reason_rules_change_unfit: the rules’ change does not fit: {detail}
reason_no_embedding_index: there is no search index with embeddings
reason_text_not_embedded: the text could not be embedded: {detail}
reason_vector_misfit: the text’s vector does not fit the index
reason_no_uploader: the document has no active uploader to look from
reason_index_unavailable: the search index cannot be asked: {detail}
reason_input_choice: Not one of the allowed values.
reason_topic_carried: Documents of “{contact}” carry the topic “{topic}”: give them another topic first.
reason_values_outside_scope: Documents outside the new scope have values.
reason_title_pattern_uses_field: The title pattern of “{type}” uses field.{key}.
reason_field_used_by_patterns: field.{key} is used by the title patterns of {types}.
reason_field_used_by_rules: field.{key} is used by the templates of the rules {rules}.
reason_field_key_taken: “{field}” would be field.{key} in templates, as “{other}” is.
reason_identifier_of_person: “{value}” is an identifier of a person.
reason_identifier_of_contact: “{value}” is already an identifier of the contact “{contact}”.
reason_profile_identifier_of_contact: “{value}” is an identifier of the contact “{contact}”.
reason_name_of_contact: “{name}” is already a name of the contact “{contact}”.
reason_name_too_close: “{name}” is too close to “{other}” of the contact “{contact}”.
reason_logo_uploaded: “{contact}” has an uploaded logo; a fetched one never replaces it.
reason_logo_type: A logo is a PNG, JPEG, WebP or ICO image.
reason_logo_upload_type: A logo is a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
reason_training_needs_examples: {confirmed} confirmed documents or decided spaces; training needs {needed}.
reason_job_not_failed: Only a failed job can be tried again.
reason_job_already_queued: The same work is queued or running already.
reason_job_retry_in_document: A failed processing step is tried again at its document; processing goes on from there.
reason_rule_follows_type: The rule of the title pattern of “{type}” follows the document type: change the pattern there.
reason_personal_space_undeletable: A personal space cannot be deleted.
reason_last_admin: The last active admin must stay an active admin.
reason_user_deletion_blocked: Deleting the user needs a decision on these spaces: {spaces}.
reason_display_name_taken: “{name}” is the name of another user.
reason_model_call_taken: Webhook “{webhook}” serves as the model call “{kind}” already.
reason_model_call_admins: Only an admin’s webhook serves as a model call.
reason_duplicate_of: This file is already in Lekto.
reason_duplicate_unseen: This file is already in Lekto, in a space you cannot see.
reason_no_text_yet: The document has no text yet.
reason_no_structure_yet: The document has no structure yet.
reason_not_waiting_for_confirmation: The document is not waiting for a confirmation.
reason_no_text_to_extract: The document has no text to read fields from.
reason_no_vision_model: No vision language model is configured.
reason_cannot_skip: Processing stopped at {nodes}; it cannot be skipped.
reason_uncertain_before_filing: The document has uncertain results; confirm them before filing.
reason_token_invalid: The token is invalid or has expired.
reason_totp_already_on: Two-factor sign-in is already on; turn it off first.
reason_no_totp_setup: There is no two-factor setup to confirm.
reason_read_only_token: This API token may only read.
reason_csrf_missing: The header {header} is missing or wrong.
reason_session_needed: This needs a signed-in session, not an API token.
reason_oidc_mismatch: The sign-in does not match the one started here.
reason_oidc_relink: Sign in again to link the account.
reason_oidc_linked_elsewhere: This account is linked to another user.
reason_oidc_no_account: No account here is linked to this sign-in.
reason_oidc_password_first: Set a password first; without it you could not sign in.
reason_page_not_found: Page {page} of document {id} was not found.
reason_rule_version_not_found: Version {number} of rule {id} was not found.
reason_no_write_access_to_document: No write access to this document.
reason_session_needed_create_user: This needs a signed-in session: an API token can only create users with the role “user” and no password.
reason_session_needed_role: This needs a signed-in session: an API token cannot change a role or the state of an admin.
reason_session_needed_profile: This needs a signed-in session: an API token sets only the display name and the e-mail address.
reason_profile_own_only: Only the user and admins see and change a profile.
reason_personal_space_describe: Only its user and admins describe a personal space.
reason_space_manage: Only editors and admins manage this space.
reason_space_members_personal: Only its user and admins choose the members of a personal space.
reason_space_members: Only editors and admins choose the members of this space.
reason_space_rule_apply: Only the space’s editors and admins apply a space rule.
reason_rule_disabled_personal_space: the personal space of “{user}” was deleted
reason_rule_disabled_choice: field “{field}” no longer allows a value the rule uses
reason_rule_webhook_gone: Rule “{rule}”: its webhook is gone or no longer belongs to whoever saved the rule; nothing sent.
reason_rule_webhook_unreadable: Rule “{rule}”: the owner of its webhook may not read the document; nothing sent.
reason_task_no_answer: Webhook “{webhook}” gave no answer in time.
reason_task_invalid: The answer of webhook “{webhook}” is invalid: {detail}
reason_task_too_large: The answer of webhook “{webhook}” is larger than {limit} bytes.
reason_task_undelivered: The request could not be delivered to webhook “{webhook}”: {error}
reason_task_run_over: The document was processed again or deleted.
reason_task_run_stopped: Processing failed meanwhile: nothing was sent to webhook “{webhook}”.
reason_rule_asks_on_arrival: Rule “{rule}” asks a webhook: it runs on arrival only, not on existing documents.
reason_not_customer_number: “{value}” is not a customer number (4 to 30 letters and digits, at least one digit).
reason_not_personnel_number: “{value}” is not a personnel number (3 to 30 letters and digits, at least one digit).
reason_free_mail_domain: “{value}” belongs to a free mail provider, not to one contact.
reason_not_tax_id: “{value}” is not a valid tax ID (11 digits with a check digit).
reason_not_social_security_number: “{value}” is not a valid social security number (12 characters with a check digit).
reason_not_health_insurance_number: “{value}” is not a valid health insurance number (a letter and 9 digits).
reason_birth_date_too_early: The birth date must not be before {date}.
reason_birth_date_in_future: The birth date is in the future.
reason_alias_twice: “{alias}” is among the other names twice.
reason_display_name_is_alias: “{name}” is the display name and one of the other names.
reason_too_many_topics: A contact enables at most {max} topics.
reason_identifier_topic_not_enabled: The topic of the identifier “{value}” is not one the contact enables.
reason_alias_is_name: The spelling “{alias}” is the contact’s name.
reason_contact_too_many_aliases: A contact has at most {max} spellings.
reason_contact_too_many_identifiers: A contact has at most {max} identifiers.
reason_only_numbers_name_users: Only a customer or personnel number names the user it belongs to.
reason_identifier_entered: “{value}” is entered at the contact by hand.
reason_identifier_contact_unclear: “{value}” stands in documents of several contacts: choose the contact.
reason_title_pattern_too_long: A title pattern has at most {max} characters.
reason_description_too_long: The description may have at most {max} characters.
reason_title_pattern_unknown: The title pattern uses {value}, which “{type}” does not know (fields: field.<key> of those that apply to the type).
reason_tag_own_parent: A tag cannot be its own parent.
reason_groups_manual: Groups are only assigned by hand.
reason_tag_parent_other_scope: “{parent}” is of another kind: a parent tag has the kind of its children.
reason_tag_under_own_child: “{tag}” cannot go under “{parent}”, which is below it.
reason_tag_too_deep: Tags are nested at most {max} levels deep.
reason_field_global_required: A field for all document types is required everywhere or nowhere, not per type.
reason_field_typed_required: A field for certain document types is required per type.
reason_field_required_own_types: A field can only be required for its own document types.
reason_choice_needs_choices: A choice field needs at least one option.
reason_choices_not_unique: Each option may appear only once.
reason_field_needs_type: Choose at least one document type, or all of them.
reason_field_only_this_type: “{field}” applies to no other document type: give it another one or delete it in its own dialog.
reason_field_not_for_type: The field “{field}” does not apply to this document type.
reason_url_not_http: “{value}” is not a full http(s) address.
reason_receipt_in_future: The receipt date must not be in the future.
reason_personal_space_name: A personal space keeps its name.
reason_personal_space_editor: The owner of a personal space always edits it.
reason_space_needs_editor: A space keeps at least one member who edits it.
reason_password_too_short: The password must have at least {min} characters.
reason_password_too_long: The password may have at most {max} characters.

reason_expiry_in_past: The expiry must be in the future.

reason_url_credentials: The URL must not contain a user name or password.
reason_url_fragment: The URL must not have a fragment (#…).

reason_icon_invalid: “{icon}” is not an icon name (lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, at most {max} characters).
reason_colour_invalid: “{colour}” is not a colour: one of the palette or #rrggbb.
reason_card_field_unknown: The field {id} on the card does not exist.
reason_due_field_not_date: The deadline must be a date field.
